Paints that can be used for filling and stroking text or paths.

Structs§

Fill

LinearGradient

MeshGradient
A mesh gradient: Coons patches, each blending its four corner colors across its curved shape, written as one PDF Type 6 shading so the viewer or RIP blends them smoothly at its own resolution. Corner opacities below 1 add a soft mask, as for the other gradients. Patches paint in order (a later one over an earlier one); a fill paints only where they lie.
